The number actually working is unconfirmed, but the design is worth copying. A group that size lets a shy person speak, and a peer has no marks to give and no parents to phone.

UNESCO's 2018 guidance, drawing on reviews of the evidence, found that curriculum-based sexuality education helps young people delay first sex, have fewer partners, take fewer risks and use condoms and contraception more [[unesco-itgse-2018]]. Quote that when a principal asks whether your session will "give them ideas". The Supreme Court agrees: in September 2024 it recommended comprehensive sex education that covers consent [[sc-just-rights-for-children-alliance-2024]].

## Before you start: ground rules, consent and a question box

Get written permission from whoever runs the space. Then agree these rules with the group, out loud, before the first question:

- No real names. Say "a friend" or "someone I know".
- Anyone can pass, step out or stay silent.
- Nobody laughs at a question.
- What is said here stays here, unless someone says that they or another child is being abused. Then you must get help.

Put a question box at the door, or share an anonymous form. Ask everyone to write something, even "no question", so nobody stands out. Answer every slip next time, including the ones meant to embarrass you. If you don't know, find out.

Imagine an NSS camp in a village outside Nashik. The girls' slips ask whether periods make them "impure". The boys' slips ask whether masturbation causes weakness. Nobody would have asked out loud.

## What to cover, including what curricula skip

Start with the body: correct names for body parts, puberty, periods, wet dreams. A 2016 meta-analysis that pooled 88 Indian studies found that only 48% of adolescent girls had been told about periods before their first one [[bmjopen-van-eijk-mhm-india-2016]]. Teach boys this too.

Then consent: a yes must be clear, a no can come at any point, and pressure or alcohol never makes a yes. POCSO protects every child under 18, boys and girls alike [[indiacode-pocso-2012]], and any sexual act with someone under 18 is an offence even if they "agreed".

Then contraception, and where to get it. In 2019-21, only 54.4% of women aged 15-24 knew where to get a condom, against 87.3% of young men [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Find your nearest Adolescent Friendly Health Centre beforehand; national guidance says these RKSK centres should not sit next to labour rooms or HIV testing centres, so young people can walk in without hesitation [[nhm-afhc-page-2026]].

Finally, the gaps. A UNESCO survey of countries in Asia-Pacific, sub-Saharan Africa and Latin America found three topics least included in secondary-school curricula: safe abortion, sexual orientation and gender identity, and online media [[unesco-cse-global-status-report-2021]]. Whatever your syllabus says, your group lives with all three, so say it plainly. Being gay, lesbian, bisexual or transgender is not an illness. Unmarried women have the same right to a legal abortion as married women [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]. Sharing a woman's private image without her consent is a crime even if she agreed to the photo [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

## Myths you will hear, and how to answer them

Don't mock whoever asks; the myth came from someone they trust.

- **"HIV spreads through mosquitoes or shared plates."** It does not, and the person asking deserves a straight answer, not a laugh.
- **"Masturbation causes weakness."** It is common and not physically harmful. Losing semen does not drain strength.
- **"A doctor can check if a girl is a virgin."** The hymen cannot show whether someone has had sex. "Virginity tests" are unscientific, and the Supreme Court has prohibited the two-finger test.
- **"Abusers are strangers."** In 96.8% of rape cases registered in India in 2024, the accused was someone the survivor knew [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

## If someone discloses abuse: what to do, and when you must report

Sooner or later, someone will stay back after a session. The government's 2007 Study on Child Abuse found that half of abusers were people known to the child or in a position of trust, and that most children told no one [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]].

Listen. Believe them. Say "this is not your fault" and "thank you for telling me". Don't push for details, and don't confront the person they name. Later, note down their words and the date.

If the person is under 18, the law decides the next step. Under POCSO, anyone who knows or suspects that a child has been sexually abused must report it to the police or the Special Juvenile Police Unit. Not reporting can mean up to six months in jail, a fine or both; an institution head who fails to report abuse by someone under them faces up to a year [[indiacode-pocso-act-2012]]. Children are exempt from that punishment, so if you are under 18, tell an adult you trust. This is why you cannot promise a child total secrecy. Tell them gently that you must get help, and whom you will tell. The Child Helpline 1098 runs 24x7 and is linked to the 112 emergency system [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]]; call it if you are unsure. This is general information, not legal advice.

If the person is an adult, reporting is their choice. Offer options, not orders: 112 in an emergency; a One Stop Centre, which gives help under one roof (985 were operational across India by July 2026) [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]]; and Tele-MANAS on 14416, a free 24x7 mental-health helpline [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

Then look after yourself: talk to a counsellor, sharing only what they must know.
youth-session-guide-peer-educators.hg:
Bahut se young Indians sex ke baare mein jo bhi jaante hain, woh doston, phone aur guesswork se jod-tod kar seekhte hain, aur yeh kami saaf dikhti hai. 2019-21 mein 15-49 saal ki 46% women ko nahi pata tha ki HIV machhar ke kaatne se nahi phailta, aur 55% ko nahi pata tha ki AIDS wale insaan ke saath khaana share karne se bhi nahi phailta [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Agar tum peer educator ho, NSS volunteer ho, ya tumhare college club ne bola hai ki "safety par ek session le lo", toh yeh guide tumhare liye hai.

## Dost woh bol paate hain jo bade nahi bolte

India ka adolescent health programme isi idea par bana hai. Rashtriya Kishor Swasthya Karyakram (RKSK) 7 January 2014 ko launch hua tha [[nhm-adolescent-health-rksk-page-2026]]. Isme har gaon ya har 1,000 logon par chaar 'Saathiya' peer educators chune jaane hain, do ladke aur do ladkiyan. Har Saathiya hafte mein ek baar, ek se do ghante ka session leta hai, 15 se 20 teenagers ke group ke saath [[nhm-peer-education-page-2026]]. Asal mein kitne Saathiya kaam kar rahe hain, yeh confirm nahi hai, par yeh design copy karne layak hai. Itne chhote group mein sharmila insaan bhi bol paata hai, aur dost ke paas na marks kaatne ki power hoti hai, na ghar phone karne ki.

UNESCO ki 2018 guidance, evidence reviews ke basis par, kehti hai ki curriculum-based sexuality education se young log pehli baar sex der se karte hain, kam partners rakhte hain, kam risk lete hain, aur condom aur contraception zyada use karte hain [[unesco-itgse-2018]]. Jab principal pooche ki "isse bachche bigad toh nahi jayenge?", toh yahi quote karo. Supreme Court bhi yahi maanta hai: September 2024 mein usne aisi comprehensive sex education recommend ki jo consent ko bhi cover kare [[sc-just-rights-for-children-alliance-2024]].

## Shuru karne se pehle: ground rules, permission aur question box

Jo bhi us jagah ka in-charge hai, usse likhit permission le lo. Phir pehle sawaal se pehle, group ke saath milkar yeh rules sabke saamne tay karo:

- Kisi ka asli naam nahi. "Meri ek dost" ya "koi jaan-pehchaan wala" bolo.
- Koi bhi pass kar sakta hai, bahar ja sakta hai ya chup reh sakta hai.
- Kisi ke sawaal par koi nahi hasega.
- Yahan ki baat yahin rahegi, jab tak koi yeh na bataye ki uska ya kisi aur bachche ka abuse ho raha hai. Tab tumhe help leni hi padegi.

Darwaze par ek question box rakho, ya anonymous form share karo. Sabko bolo ki slip par kuch na kuch likhein, chahe "koi sawaal nahi" hi sahi, taaki koi alag se nazar na aaye. Agli baar har slip ka jawab do, unka bhi jo tumhe sharminda karne ke liye likhi gayi hon. Jawab nahi pata, toh pata karke aao.

Socho, Nashik ke paas kisi gaon mein NSS camp laga hai. Ladkiyon ki slips poochti hain ki kya periods mein woh "ashuddh" ho jaati hain. Ladkon ki slips poochti hain ki kya masturbation se kamzori aati hai. Yeh sawaal koi bhi zor se nahi poochta.

## Kya cover karna hai, woh bhi jo syllabus chhod deta hai

Shuruaat body se karo: body parts ke sahi naam, puberty, periods, wet dreams. 2016 ke ek meta-analysis mein, jisne 88 Indian studies ka data milaya, mila ki sirf 48% teenage ladkiyon ko pehle period se pehle periods ke baare mein bataya gaya tha [[bmjopen-van-eijk-mhm-india-2016]]. Yeh ladkon ko bhi sikhao.

Phir consent: haan clear honi chahiye, na kabhi bhi aa sakti hai, aur pressure ya sharaab se nikli haan, haan nahi hoti. POCSO 18 se kam umar ke har bachche ko protect karta hai, ladka ho ya ladki [[indiacode-pocso-2012]], aur 18 se kam umar ke kisi ke saath koi bhi sexual act is law mein offence hai, chahe woh "maan gaya" ho.

Phir contraception, aur woh milta kahan hai. 2019-21 mein 15-24 saal ki sirf 54.4% women ko pata tha ki condom kahan milta hai, jabki young men mein yeh 87.3% tha [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Session se pehle apne paas ka Adolescent Friendly Health Centre dhoondh lo. National guidance kehti hai ki RKSK ke yeh centres labour room ya HIV testing centre ke bagal mein na hon, taaki young log bina jhijhak andar ja sakein [[nhm-afhc-page-2026]].

Aakhir mein gaps. Asia-Pacific, sub-Saharan Africa aur Latin America ke countries ke ek UNESCO survey mein secondary-school syllabus mein teen topics sabse kam shaamil mile: safe abortion, sexual orientation aur gender identity, aur online media [[unesco-cse-global-status-report-2021]]. Tumhara syllabus jo bhi kahe, tumhare group ki life mein teeno hain, toh seedha bolo. Gay, lesbian, bisexual ya transgender hona koi bimari nahi hai. Unmarried women ko legal abortion ka utna hi haq hai jitna married women ko [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]. Kisi woman ki private photo uski consent ke bina share karna crime hai, chahe woh photo khinchwane ke liye maan gayi thi [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

## Yeh myths tum zaroor sunoge, aur unka jawab

Jo bhi pooche, uska mazaak mat udao; yeh myth usne kisi bharose wale insaan se hi suna hoga.

- **"HIV machhar se ya ek thaali mein khaane se phailta hai."** Nahi phailta, aur poochne wale ko hansi nahi, seedha jawab milna chahiye.
- **"Masturbation se kamzori aati hai."** Yeh common hai aur body ko koi nuksaan nahi karta. Semen nikalne se taakat nahi ghatti.
- **"Doctor check karke bata sakta hai ki ladki virgin hai ya nahi."** Hymen dekh kar pata nahi chalta ki kisi ne sex kiya hai ya nahi. "Virginity tests" unscientific hain, aur Supreme Court ne two-finger test par rok lagayi hai.
- **"Abuse karne wale strangers hote hain."** 2024 mein India mein register hue rape cases mein se 96.8% mein accused koi aisa tha jise survivor pehle se jaanti thi [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

## Agar koi abuse ke baare mein bataye: kya karna hai, aur kab report karna zaroori hai

Kabhi na kabhi, session ke baad koi ruk jayega. Sarkar ki 2007 ki Study on Child Abuse mein mila ki abuse karne walon mein aadhe log bachche ke jaan-pehchaan wale ya bharose ki position wale the, aur zyada tar bachchon ne kisi ko kuch nahi bataya [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]].

Dhyaan se suno. Unki baat par bharosa karo. Bolo, "isme tumhari koi galti nahi hai" aur "mujhe batane ke liye thank you". Details ke liye kuredo mat, aur jis insaan ka naam liya gaya hai usse jaakar confront mat karo. Baad mein unke words aur date note kar lo.

Agar batane wala 18 se kam hai, toh agla step law decide karta hai. POCSO ke hisaab se jise bhi pata ho ya shak ho ki kisi bachche ka sexual abuse hua hai, use police ya Special Juvenile Police Unit ko report karna hi hoga. Report na karne par chhe mahine tak ki jail, fine ya dono ho sakte hain; aur kisi institution ka head agar apne neeche kaam karne wale ke abuse ko report na kare, toh use ek saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai [[indiacode-pocso-act-2012]]. Yeh punishment bachchon par laagu nahi hoti, toh agar tum khud 18 se kam ho, kisi bharosemand adult ko batao. Isi wajah se tum kisi bachche se poori secrecy ka promise nahi kar sakte. Unhe pyaar se batao ki tumhe help leni padegi, aur tum kise bataoge. Child Helpline 1098 24x7 chalti hai aur 112 emergency system se judi hai [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]]; samajh na aaye toh wahan call karo. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

Agar batane wala adult hai, toh report karna hai ya nahi, yeh unka decision hai. Order mat do, options do: emergency mein 112; One Stop Centre, jahan ek hi chhat ke neeche madad milti hai (July 2026 tak India mein aise 985 centres chal rahe the) [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]]; aur Tele-MANAS 14416, jo free, 24x7 mental-health helpline hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

Phir apna bhi khayal rakho: kisi counsellor se baat karo, aur sirf utna batao jitna zaroori ho.
